title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: bullseye routing with user groups expands the eligible pool as wait time grows
summary: The routing behaviour, prerequisites, credit-consumption trigger and documented record operations are supported by Microsoft Learn, and the release details match the roadmap. The creation path stops before Publish, and the diagnostics checklist step has no corresponding controls row; these are minor corrections.
